For you, Eva. Always with love. Irfan Zikry ♡
To Eva,
I wish I could lend you my eyes so you could see yourself through as I do. Through these eyes of mine, you would witness the beauty that radiates from your presence, the gentleness in your eyes that warms my heart, the smile that lights up my darkest day. You would see the strength within you when the world overwhelms you with its weight. You would also know that your imperfections, no matter how much you hate them, are still dear to me; I would crawl inside your soul, find the broken parts, and still love them. If only you could see through my eyes, you would understand that to me, all your forms are beautiful.
From Irfan Zikry
